shared_bottleneck.purpose: Competing aircraft use a constrained taxiway and node.

route_choice_interaction.purpose: An agent can choose a direct or shared route.

closure_disruption.purpose: A deterministic route closure affects active traffic.

priority_conflict.purpose: Arrivals and departures compete for shared surface access.

fairness_contention.purpose: Repeated bottleneck contention is used to inspect wait aging and completion order.

non_beneficial_coordination.purpose: Low-conflict baseline where coordination may add cost without benefit.

shared_runway_entry_queue.purpose: Synthetic extended runway-entry occupancy creates a longer shared-edge queue.

long_shared_corridor.purpose: Synthetic longer merge corridor makes route overlap more costly.

early_closure_merge.purpose: Synthetic early edge closure forces active routes to converge.

coordinated_route_choice.purpose: Synthetic route-choice case where shared-route cost changes one movement decision.
